findings.claim: The new blocking failed/lech rows are not reachable through the required A4 acquisition/validation contract. Section 6.8 discovers only successful measurement runs and requires the document to be passed with the complete successful key set, following nhap_wd. Section 8 explicitly applies its table to artifacts already checked by 6.8. Actual do_wd failures make the measurement workflow fail, omit blob/sha256, and are rejected by that prerequisite as not_measured. A newer failed measurement can also be hidden by the success-only discovery filter. Thus the direct WD_JSON comparator tests can pass while the real acquisition path still loses the positive failure that this revision intends to make blocking.

evidence.observed_result: Probe rc 0. All six actual do_wd cases (databaseId, repo, url_path, file_path, oid_head_sha, oid_check_suite) return rc 12 / failed and lack blob and sha256. Existing nhap_wd through its CLI test seam accepts the healthy control, but measurement conclusion=failure returns not_measured / wd_khong_hop_le:a:conclusion; a failed document returns not_measured / wd_khong_hop_le:c:trang_thai; a wrong document repository returns not_measured / wd_khong_hop_le:c:repo.

The existing workflow exits with the producer rc and uploads wd.json with always(), so a failed measurement has an inspectable artifact but a failed workflow. SPEC 135 requires success/passed; table heading 149 requires prior 6.8 validation, while 154-155 require those same rejected failures to block. This is a contract contradiction, not a run of a B1 implementation.

findings.suggested_fix: Separate trusted transport/identity/digest verification from the successful-provenance predicate. For B1 canary comparison, retrieve the explicitly dispatched measurement run even when it failed; preserve verified failed and mismatching documents for the blocking classification without requiring passed-only fields. Define discovery over the latest matching measurement irrespective of success, with no fallback to an older successful result. Keep B3 acceptance fail-closed. Add end-to-end acquisition-to-comparison fixtures for all six real failed shapes and for older-success/newer-failure, with dedicated target-exception mutants. No change to the excluded ci_provenance.py is authorized by this suggestion.

findings.claim: The new structured diagnostics repair the R-only reduction, but some codes marked independently recomputable still lack sufficient or stable evidence in the frozen receipt. P_THIEU uses the collector stamp as the validator reference, while the producer compares every stamp, including that collector stamp, with an independent checkout enumeration. A faulty collector stamp makes those two sets disagree. C_CHE_DO is also marked recomputable although the selected receipt raw so_manh, which rule C must validate, is absent from the closed Manh shape. An executor must either change the schema, trust supposedly recomputable codes, or reject legitimate diagnostic receipts as inconsistent.

evidence.observed_result: Probe rc 0. Explicitly labelled set witness: with checkout requirements={requirements.txt}, removing the entry from dot-bien-du yields the same P_THIEU job on both sides. Removing it only from bien-nhan-audit yields producer P_THIEU={bien-nhan-audit}, but the section-109 validator rule yields the ten other jobs instead. Current _loi_mot_bien_nhan rejects raw so_manh=9 for expected 8; the frozen copied Manh fields have no raw so_manh. These are specification counterexamples, not tests of unimplemented B1 code.

PhuThuoc is copied from the selected stamp; line 109 declares the self stamp the standard for P_THIEU; line 120 instead requires independently enumerating checkout files. Line 110 demands exact equality of all row-recomputable diagnostic pairs. Manh has expected-position manh and copied fields, but no copied so_manh; free-text loi and opaque artifact hashes do not supply its integer value to the receipt-only validator.

findings.suggested_fix: Audit every code marked dong=co against the serialized fields. Store an independently derived expected requirements set rather than treating a possibly faulty self stamp as ground truth, and retain the raw selected shard dimensions needed for C. Alternatively explicitly classify facts that cannot be reconstructed as producer assertions, consistently with the R_LECH design. Freeze exact doi_tuong rules for each code. Require producer-to-validator round trips for every negative diagnostic class, including a bad collector stamp and wrong raw shard count, plus missing/spurious-code mutants classified by each case exception. This is the third review appearance of B1-04: apply the protocol section-12 design checkpoint before another ordinary repair loop.

findings.claim: The new required dependency maps close the empty-map cases, but the prescribed executable-version extraction still permits a measured value that contains no version. ShellCheck --version prints a fixed product banner on its first line; the actual version is on its second line. Following section 3 literally records the same nonempty banner for different installed ShellCheck versions, and Do plus rule P accepts it as do_duoc. The required tool-version provenance is therefore still incomplete.

evidence.command: GitHub read-only GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/koalaman/shellcheck/v0.10.0/shellcheck.hs and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/koalaman/shellcheck/v0.11.0/shellcheck.hs; inspect printVersion at lines 620-624
evidence.observed_result: Both official tagged sources first print "ShellCheck - shell script analysis tool" and then print "version: " concatenated with shellcheckVersion. Thus taking only the first line loses the version. This is source inspection; ShellCheck is absent locally and no native version probe is claimed.

The repository already uses a version: capture regex for ShellCheck. SPEC instead requires the first --version line for executable tools; Do accepts any nonempty string and P checks presence/availability, so the fixed banner satisfies the stated green conditions.

findings.suggested_fix: Specify tool-specific extraction of the version-bearing line or capture, preserving the stdlib-only stamp constraint. Treat missing/unparseable version text as khong_do_duoc rather than accepting a banner. Test two different valid ShellCheck version outputs, a banner-only response and a command failure, with a dedicated mutant that substitutes the first line. Keep the completed required-key/hash/availability checks.

findings.claim: The all-input equivalence required between the new diagnostic selection and unchanged chon_bien_nhan_du conflicts with the new REST-bound selection rules. The old helper only sees artifact directories, while the new selected producer must match the latest REST attempt of each job. When REST has a newer attempt with no uploaded receipt, the old helper accepts eight older receipts but B1 must select no producer for that shard and emit A_TRON. The contract simultaneously demands the same valid 8/8 selection for that input and forbids it. New hash/key-inventory checks likewise intentionally go beyond the old helper.

evidence.observed_result: Probe rc 0. On a current-source healthy eight-shard artifact fixture, actual chon_bien_nhan_du returns errors=[] and all eight attempt-1 producers. The same artifact input with latest REST attempt 2 for shard 0 cannot be selected under SPEC 114/122 because its attempt-2 receipt is absent. The legacy function has no REST parameter, so its result cannot change. The added REST premise and required B1 result are explicitly labelled specification deductions.

Probe rc 0. Actual legacy selector also accepts wrong_hash and missing_expected_key fixtures with errors=[] and selected_count=8; B1 rule M is required to reject those. Healthy/repaired-rerun controls pass and latest-corrupt receipt has errors with zero selection.

findings.suggested_fix: Distinguish legacy artifact parsing/selection compatibility from the later B1 admission rules. State the equivalence only for the exact legacy predicate and input domain, then apply REST-attempt/hash/inventory checks separately; do not call the resulting B1-valid set universally equivalent to the old helper. Add the newer-REST-attempt-without-artifact counterexample and explicit paired controls demonstrating intentional new rejection while the old CLI result stays unchanged. Keep the existing selector and excluded mutation code unchanged.
